name: Zombie Rhythm
memo: The Cranberries - Zombie: verses on a chorus-washed clean-ish crunch, chorus on a big fuzzy wall (Big Muff into cranked Marshall/AC30 sound). Informed approximation.

band.style_feel: mid-tempo straight rock, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4; quiet verses, huge choruses
parts: Part A: intro/verse - sparse drums, clean-ish guitar
Part B: chorus - full band, distorted guitar
band.tips: The whole song loops Em - C - G - D (D/F# on the record). 86 BPM comes from a sheet-music arrangement, not a measurement of the recording, so check it against the track. Play 2 bars of the progression cleanly before the Trio+ starts learning.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
how: Leave the Whammy DT off; play in standard tuning.
whammy.tips: No alternate tuning or pitch effect was found for this recording.

guitar.tone_notes: Hogan says the sound is a blend of an ES-335, a Les Paul and a Tele/Strat through cranked Marshalls and AC30s, with a Big Muff for the heavy parts. Any guitar works; with single-coils add a little gain.

name: Zombie Chorus
memo: The Cranberries - Zombie (chorus/lead): fuzz-style wall of distortion, Big Muff into cranked amps. Informed approximation.
